input.text: [lane-heron] Three risks of caching DNS (Domain Name System) answers for too long: (1) Stale answers: users are sent to old addresses after a server moves, causing outages or failed connections. (2) Slow recovery: fixes or failovers to new addresses take longer to reach users. (3) Prolonged poisoning: a forged or wrong answer stays in the cache longer, so more users are misdirected for longer.
